hypothesis: input_edge_receipts must never pair or expose timing when an adapter DOWN or UP row is duplicated within the same identity group; exact-one cardinality is necessary so replayed or contradictory duplicate trace rows cannot be silently attributed to a single physical edge.
treatment: Replay retained A01 unique DOWN/UP rows and five controlled duplicate variants: duplicate identical DOWN; duplicate identical UP; duplicate both; conflicting duplicate DOWN; conflicting duplicate UP. Run exact frozen input_edge_receipts extracted from controller source, then run a first-row-wins cardinality mutation control.
decision_rule: PASS only if unique baseline yields exactly one adapter_edge_brackets_paired receipt with both intervals; each duplicate treatment yields exactly one adapter_edge_receipt_incomplete receipt with both intervals null; no case claims authority or application consumption and no raw intent token is emitted; weakened exact-one guard pairs duplicate cases, proving sensitivity. Any mismatch is FAIL; harness/runtime failure is STOP. No retries.
controls: Same retained A01 raw rows; identical and contradictory duplicates; weakened cardinality guard negative control.
uncertainty: One retained synthetic A01 fixture only; does not establish physical release, live X-server state, application consumption, game effect, threat response, recovery, or MAP01 completion.
